boundary.profile: Temporary isolated local-qualification, OpenAI-compatible llamacpp transport to the existing InferenceBridge endpoint.
boundary.isolation: Disposable settings and temporary file fixtures outside the source checkout; no shell, browser, MCP, remote target or cloud actions.

fixes: Separate normal greeting/composition/advice and short observed answers from tool-requiring actions; preserve explicit named-file actions when delivery is in Chat.
Use whole-word live-data and repair intent instead of substring collisions such as fixture/suffix/deliverable/planet.
Seal expected literal-file size/hash and original append prefix in the immutable task contract. Require current exact bytes and this run's native write witness before completion.
Keep mixed goals under ordinary semantic rails; do not skip blocking review when tool/run budget is exhausted.
Validate contract digest, run ID and control revision before passing completion.
Close only the owned HTTP stream/context on cancellation; remove delayed server-wide inference cancellation.
diagnosticNotes: Initial cancellation/idle false failures included a 1 MiB metadata decode limit; runtime history exceeded it. The harness now uses a finite 8 MiB metadata budget and verifies idle after cancellation.
Iterations 2 and 3 stopped during metadata preflight; they are not scored matrices.
The initial source-nested fixture inherited repository instructions. Final fixtures have a separate disposable workspace and explicit instruction file.
The v1 grader could accept a write with unresolved review failures after budget exhaustion. The v2 grader rejects unresolved blocking verdicts; original reports remain retained.

finalGuardAudit.scope: The final completion contract-validation guard was tightened after the live matrix process had compiled. All 65 primary, five follow-up and ten recovery snapshots were revalidated against that final guard, including current exact artifact bytes; no actions were replayed.

reproduction.inputs: An already loaded idle loopback model; existing credential supplied ephemerally with MAULER_LOCAL_EVAL_KEY or INFERENCE_BRIDGE_API_KEY; fresh -OutputRoot; -Repeats 5; cached Go 1.27.3 via -GoBinary when the system SDK is older.
reproduction.admissionAuditTest: TestRecheckRetainedLocalCompletionAdmissions requires explicit absolute MAULER_LOCAL_RECHECK_REPORT and fresh MAULER_LOCAL_RECHECK_OUTPUT; no provider key or model is needed.

remainingUnqualified: Native Wails Send/Stop/New chat/workspace-switch UI lifecycle and event delivery; the matrix exercises the headless production agent loop, not those entry points.
Mauler whole-app hard crash, automatic restart, physical reboot/power loss, and persistent terminal/descendant recovery.
Broader browser, remote, channel, MCP and long unattended mixed-task reliability.
The original fresh 12/12 UI Gate 1, full Agent Eval x5 and context M5 acceptance remain open.
General semantic correctness, arbitrary natural-language byte expectations, atomic file snapshots and OS filesystem containment are not certified by this bounded literal-file verifier.
